Name: Shashank Singh
Research Area: Plant circadian regulatory networks & mathematical modelling
Bio: Builds large-scale ODE models of the plant circadian regulatory network to understand how feedback loops and environmental inputs generate robust ~24-hour rhythms and seasonal adaptation.

Name: Shriyansh Srivastava
Bio: Explores how circadian rhythms, gene networks and muscle biology intersect — from small-molecule mechanisms to the structural interplay between MYOD1 and BMAL1.

Name: Karthick Sudarsanam
Bio: Studies macromolecular structure and dynamics computationally, focused on the core clock transcription factor that regulates circadian rhythm.

Name: Yashasvi Rao
Bio: Uses molecular dynamics and wet-lab methods to compare ligand-bound and unbound REV-ERB isoform structures, refining how these nuclear receptors act as repressors.

Name: Pooja Roham
Research Area: Circadian clock as target for oral cancer
Bio: Studies the circadian clock as a target in oral cancer, combining computational and experimental approaches toward better treatment and diagnosis.

Name: Prithvi Gollakota
Bio: Runs all-atom molecular dynamics simulations of Tau aggregation in Tauopathies, aiming to identify small-molecule modulators that disrupt aggregation pathways.

Name: Shreya
Bio: Investigates the activation mechanism of the allatostatin receptor, an insect GPCR and emerging pest-control target, using molecular dynamics and docking.

Name: Bibhu Sahoo
Bio: Develops ODE and nonlinear-dynamics models of plant gene regulatory networks to understand their response to natural light and temperature.

Name: Kaushal S
Bio: Studies REV-ERB protein structure and interaction mechanisms, combining computational biology with drug-design approaches.
